# All tools

<!-- generated by scripts/build_pages.py from data/workflows.yml: do not edit by hand -->

Each tool runs in your browser. Nothing you type is sent anywhere or stored.
Each one gives the same results as the handbook's Python package `esgcalc`,
and is tested against it.

| Tool | What it does | Used in |
|---|---|---|
| [CBAM calculator](cbam-calculator.md) | A free CBAM calculator that runs in your browser. Enter imports by CN code and net mass, actual or default emissions, and a certificate price; get the 50-tonne threshold result, embedded emissions, certificates, cost and the quarterly holding. | [CB1](../cbam/cb1-scope-check.md), [CB4](../cbam/cb4-embedded-emissions.md), [CB8](../cbam/cb8-certificates.md) |
| [DMA scoring](dma-scoring.md) | A free double materiality scoring tool that runs in your browser. Score impacts, risks and opportunities on a 1 to 5 scale and see which ESRS topics are material. | [C2](../csrd/c2-dma.md) |
| [ESRS gap check](esrs-gap.md) | A free ESRS datapoint gap check that runs in your browser. Choose your material topics, give each datapoint in scope a status, and see what is ready and what is missing. | [C7](../csrd/c7-gap-analysis.md) |
| [Scope 3 screening](scope3-screening.md) | A free Scope 3 screening tool that runs in your browser. Enter a rough estimate for each of the 15 categories, a size threshold and any other reasons; see each category's share and which are significant. | [S2](../scope3/s2-screening.md) |
| [Uncertainty demo](uncertainty-demo.md) | A free Monte Carlo uncertainty demo that runs in your browser. Enter emissions lines with their 95% uncertainty; compare the sum rule with a simulation and see the histogram. | [F2](../foundations/data-quality.md) |
| [VSME readiness](vsme-readiness.md) | A free VSME readiness check that runs in your browser. Tick the datapoints of the voluntary standard you already have; see completeness by module and a to-do list. | [V2](../vsme/v2-basic.md) |

Templates to download are listed on [All templates](../templates.md).
